verses.text: Ha tiknaik, tik swalb'at juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'ayex ex ankiano ay t'a junjun chonhab', yujto a in tik, ankiano in pax heyet'ok. Wilnak wal Cristo chi', wilnak chajtil ajnak yab'an syail. Ay walan wik in chaan swach'il heyet'ok, haton jun toto ol cheklajelok.

Icha yaj heb' tanhwum kalnel, icha chi' tzeyutej he tanhwan heb' ay t'a yol he k'ab' heyilani, yujto icha skalnel Dios yaj heb' t'ayex. Manh ak'b'ilok pural tzex utaji, manh yujok he nib'anoch tumin tzeyil heb'. Palta yujnhejokab' to icha chi' tz'el t'a he k'ool to tzeyil heb', yujto icha chi' snib'ej Dios t'ayex. Tzex munlaj wal t'a tzalajk'olal.
Max yal yajal tzeyutej he b'a t'a heb' ay t'a yol he k'ab'. Palta a he wach' b'eyb'al tze ch'ox yil heb', yik a tas tze b'eyb'alej chi' ol sb'eyb'alej heb'.
Tato icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a, ayik ol ja jun Kilumal Niwan Yelk'ochi, ol he cha spak te niwan swach'il. Ha jun chi' malaj b'ak'uinh ol lajwok.

Ha exxo ex kelemtak yet' ex kob'estak, tze k'anab'ajej wal heb' ankiano. Ichokab' ex chi' he masanil, emnakil tzeyutej eyak'an serwil he b'a junjun ex. Yujto syal t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkan icha tik: Ha Dios schakanel heb' syik'chaanh sb'a, haxo pax t'a heb' emnakilal syutej sb'a, syak' wal swach'k'olal, xchi.
Yuj chi' emnakil skutejek ko b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Dios, yujto te niwan spoder. Tato icha chi', niwan ol onh ajelk'och yuj, ayik ol ja stiempoal.
Kak'ekoch masanil kilk'olal t'a yol sk'ab', yujto aypaxoch ilk'olal kuuj.
Lista skutej ko b'a ko makwaji, yujto icha yaj nok' choj tz'el yaw tzek' sayek' schib'ej, icha chi' yek' winh ajk'ool t'a ko patik kichanh, haton winh diablo.

Te tek'anokab' skutej kak'anoch Dios t'a ko k'ool, yik ol yal ko kolan ko b'a t'a winh. Yujto kojtak to a heb' ketkreyenteal sakleminak yajb'at t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, wan pax yab'an juntzanh yaelal heb' icha onh tik.

Ayik ol lajwok kab'an syail janik'ok tiempoal, haxo Dios ol onh wach' tz'aktzitanok, ol swach' ak'ej ko tek'anil yet' kip. Manh jantakok swach'k'olal, yuj chi' ix onh yawtejoch yikok, yik wach' ay kalan kik t'a swach'il ay t'a junelnhej, yujto junxonhej kaj yet' Jesucristo.
Niwanokab' yelk'ochi, niwanokab' spoder t'a masanil tiempo. Amén.

Ha winh kuk'tak Silvano tik, wojtak spensar winh, sk'anab'ajej wal winh. Ha winh ol ik'anb'at jun in karta tik t'ayex. Tzin tz'ib'ejb'at jay b'elanh lolonel tik, yik ol wach' ja he pensar. Ha juntzanh tik tz'alani chajtil syutej Dios yak'an swach'k'olal t'ayonh t'a wal yel. Ha t'a swach'k'olal tik, tek'an tzeyutej he b'a.
Ha heb' ketkreyenteal ay t'a Babilonia tik, sik'b'ilxoel heb' heyet'ok, syak'b'at stzatzil he k'ool heb'. Yet' pax winhaj Marcos tik, winh icha wuninal yaji, syak'paxb'at stzatzil he k'ool winh.
Slaj eyak'laj stzatzil he k'ool yuj he xajanan he b'a. Yak'okab' sjunk'olal Dios t'ayex he masanil ex yik exxo Jesucristo ta'.
